remarks: Welcome home to this fabulous like new construction home on a sought after street in Darien. Incredible updates and high end finishes will blow you away including light fixtures and window treatments throughout. Opportunity awaits to live in this amazing 5348 SF center hall colonial with gorgeous Wagner pool! Flow is everything here at 4 Echo Drive. Sun drenched rooms flow into the next with gorgeous white/grey kitchen by Deane & attached family room with fireplace for easy living and entertaining. Second floor boasts a magnificent master suite with stunning bath and two closets. Additional three bedrooms and laundry on the second floor. Third floor offers another en suite bedroom and optional lay out for living including a great office space! Four levels of living, professional landscaped level yard with six foot fence for privacy in your pool. This beauty is just waiting for you!
